_comment: Full-time science, engineering and health graduate enrolment by institution, and the share held by temporary-visa holders, from the GSS Race sheet where 'forgn' is the STUDENT'S CITIZENSHIP. (In the GSS Support sheet the same token means a foreign SOURCE OF FUNDS; that sheet is not used here.) COUNTS ARE ENROLMENTS, not degrees, and the field basis is S&E&H units -- neither is comparable with the IPEDS core-STEM degree rankings elsewhere in this project. Ranked by share only above an enrolment floor, because a small programme produces meaningless percentages; the by_count ranking has no floor since a large count is already evidence of scale. Permanent residents are counted under their race and so appear as domestic here. Single year, 2024.
source: NSF NCSES, Survey of Graduate Students and Postdoctorates, 2024
